title: Kayak Explore Cheapest Destinations Scraper
description: Explore Kayak flight destinations from an origin airport with city, country, date window, airline, stops, duration, and fare-search link. Batch origins and set a map area.

origins.title: Origin airports
origins.description: Origin airports whose lowest available destinations you want to explore.

origin.title: Origin
origin.description: Origin airport code for the route or destination search.

departure_from.title: Departure From
departure_from.description: First outbound date in the destination exploration window. When omitted, the departure window starts 30 days from today.

departure_to.title: Departure To
departure_to.description: Last outbound date in the destination exploration window. When omitted, the departure window ends seven days after it starts.

return_from.title: Return From
return_from.description: First possible return date in the destination exploration window. When omitted, the return window starts seven days after the first departure date.

return_to.title: Return To
return_to.description: Last possible return date in the destination exploration window. When omitted, the return window ends seven days after it starts.

min_days.title: Min Days
min_days.description: Minimum trip length in days for destination suggestions.

max_days.title: Max Days
max_days.description: Maximum trip length in days for destination suggestions.

stops.title: Stops
stops.description: Maximum flight stop count for destination suggestions.

north_east_lat.title: North East Lat
north_east_lat.description: Northern latitude of the northeast corner of the destination map area.

north_east_lng.title: North East Lng
north_east_lng.description: Eastern longitude of the northeast corner of the destination map area.

south_west_lat.title: South West Lat
south_west_lat.description: Southern latitude of the southwest corner of the destination map area.

south_west_lng.title: South West Lng
south_west_lng.description: Western longitude of the southwest corner of the destination map area.
